    • engineVersion

      static String engineVersion(String classpath)
      The Robocode version in a classpath string, read from its robocode.core jar's name (Maven's robocode.core-<version>.jar), or "unknown" when there is none. The engine can be swapped with -Drobocode.version=... (issue #109), so the report says which one ran rather than assuming the pom's default.

    • allReference

      static boolean allReference(Map<Opponent,List<BattleResult>> results)
      True when every battle that ran was fought by a reference build (issue #138), not a Hadur one.

    • tallyLine

      static String tallyLine(String label, List<Integer> perBattle, String trailer)
      A per-battle count (skipped turns, duress ticks) as the report's one-line tally: the total over the battles, the mean per battle and the worst single battle. Shared by the duel, melee and team reports so the three read alike (issue #102, BENCH-12).

    • pairedDiff

      static Stats pairedDiff(List<BattleResult> candidate, List<BattleResult> baseline)
      BENCH-2: the paired score-share difference (candidate minus baseline) over one opponent's seeds. The lists are paired by seed index (both are seed 1..runs, in order) and only the seeds where both jars produced a battle are kept, so a lone failure on one side cannot shift every later seed's pairing out of alignment.

    • pairedDiff

      static Stats pairedDiff(List<BattleResult> candidate, List<BattleResult> baseline, ToDoubleFunction<BattleResult> metric, boolean trustedOnly)
      The same pairing for any per-battle metric. With trustedOnly a pair is kept only when both battles are trusted (issue #117, G2), which is the sensitivity check.

    • signedDiff

      static String signedDiff(Stats diff, double scale)
      A paired difference as "+1.2 ± 3.4" (the BENCH-2 convention: mean, then the 95% half-width when two or more pairs exist), or "n/a" with no pairs. scale turns a fraction into points (100) or leaves points alone (1).

    • renderPaired

      static String renderPaired(Map<Opponent,List<BattleResult>> candidate, Map<Opponent,List<BattleResult>> baseline, String candidateRobot, String baselineRobot)
      BENCH-2: the paired score-share difference per opponent between the candidate and baseline jars, seed for seed, plus a BENCH-1 stratified APS estimate for each jar from the set's opponent weights (0 when the set carries none).

    • renderRoundSplit

      static String renderRoundSplit(List<RoundSeries.Row> rows, String candidate, String baseline)
      G3: the first rounds of a battle against the last ones, per opponent, from the per-round series (see RoundSeries). Hadur learns within a battle, so a change can help the cold start, the mature model, or both. Battles shorter than 15 rounds are left out so the two windows never overlap. baseline may be null.

      One opponent's own report: a per-battle table (seed by seed, with the baseline and the paired difference when a baseline ran), then every section of the full report for that opponent alone.

    • renderConditions

      static String renderConditions(Map<String,Map<Opponent,List<BattleResult>>> byCondition, Map<String,String> cpuByCondition)
      BENCH-4: survival share and skipped turns per opponent, one section per client condition. A condition with no results (an engine/java not available locally) is reported as not run rather than omitted.
